SELECT 
    e."EQUIP_CODE" as equip_ref_code,
    (pb.battery_telemetry->'power_state'->>'conversion_eff_pct')::real as efficiency_level,
    pb.battery_telemetry->'power_state'->>'primary_source' as power_source,
    ROUND(CAST(
        (pb.battery_telemetry->'power_state'->>'conversion_eff_pct')::numeric * 
        CASE 
            WHEN pb.battery_telemetry->'power_state'->>'primary_source' IN ('Solar', 'Wind', 'Hybrid') THEN 1.5
            WHEN pb.battery_telemetry->'power_state'->>'primary_source' = 'Battery' THEN 1.0
            WHEN pb.battery_telemetry->'power_state'->>'primary_source' = 'Diesel' THEN 0.7
            ELSE 0
        END
    AS numeric), 2) as sustainability_rating
FROM "Equipment" e
JOIN "PowerBattery" pb ON e."EQUIP_CODE" = pb."equip_ref"
LIMIT 10;
